title: Route UserProfileHeaderCard's 9 raw Color literals through AppColors tokens (no_color_literal_outside_theme)
why: The custom_lint rule no_color_literal_outside_theme currently enforces nothing repo-wide (dart run custom_lint is broken -- baselined), but the underlying violations are still real and reportable per the audit digest. This widget already imports and uses AppColors.inkMidGrey/AppColors.surfaceE9 (lines 231, 277) for some colors, yet inlines 9 fresh Color(0x...) hex literals for the parent/tutor badge pair, the avatar ring, two shadow tints, and the cloud-off icon/text -- one of which (0xFFE65100, line 142) is byte-for-byte identical to the already-defined AppColors.accentBurntOrange (app_colors.dart:188). A future rebrand of that accent color would silently miss this usage.
recommendation: Add named tokens to AppColors for the badge-pair and shadow-tint colors, replace all 9 literals with AppColors.* references (reusing accentBurntOrange for the 0xFFE65100 case).
acceptance_criteria: 0 raw Color(0x literals remain in user_profile_header_card.dart.
no_color_literal_outside_theme passes on this file once custom_lint is repaired.
